intro: This Acceptable Use Policy ('Policy') governs the use of all services provided by ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD, a private limited company registered in England and Wales (Company Number: 17474730; Registered Office: Office 1878 85 Dunstall Hill, Wolverhampton, WV6 0SR, United Kingdom) ('Company,' 'we,' 'us,' or 'our'). ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD provides lawful product procurement, custom order fulfillment, shipment coordination, and related services primarily for business clients, while also serving individual customers on a project basis. By accessing or using our services, you ('Client,' 'User,' or 'you') agree to comply with and be bound by this Policy. This Policy is incorporated by reference into our Terms of Service and applies to all clients, partners, vendors, and any other parties who interact with our services. Violation of this Policy may result in immediate suspension or termination of services, reporting to relevant authorities, and pursuit of all available legal remedies.

sections.heading: 1. Permitted Uses
sections.body: Permitted uses of our services include: (a) submitting lawful product procurement requests for commercial or personal use; (b) placing custom order fulfillment requests for legitimate goods; (c) coordinating international shipment of lawful goods through our fulfillment process; (d) requesting product inspection, packaging, and order preparation services; (e) obtaining written quotations and placing approved orders; and (f) any other product procurement, order fulfillment, or shipment coordination activity expressly authorised in writing by ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD. Customers are responsible for providing complete and accurate information regarding their identity, products, destination, and order requirements. All permitted uses must comply with applicable laws, including export-control requirements, sanctions regulations, customs requirements, and applicable carrier and payment-provider policies.

sections.heading: 2. Prohibited Activities
sections.body: The following activities are strictly prohibited when using our procurement, fulfillment, shipment-coordination, or related services: (a) misrepresenting the nature, origin, quantity, or value of any goods submitted for procurement, fulfillment, or shipment; (b) providing false, inaccurate, or misleading information in any order documentation, customs declaration, or business record; (c) using our services to facilitate fraud, money laundering, terrorist financing, or any other financial crime; (d) unauthorised access to, or interference with, our website, systems, or data; (e) harvesting, scraping, or collecting data from our website or systems without authorisation; (f) subletting, reselling, or transferring access to our services to unauthorised third parties without prior written consent; (g) engaging in any activity that disrupts, degrades, or impairs the performance of our services; (h) using our services to circumvent export controls, trade sanctions, or embargo regulations; (i) engaging in predatory, deceptive, or unfair business practices in connection with our services; and (j) any activity that violates the rights of third parties, including privacy rights, intellectual property rights, or contractual rights.

sections.heading: 3. Prohibited Products and Services
sections.body: ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD maintains a strict zero-tolerance policy regarding the procurement, fulfillment, transportation, or facilitation of the following categories of products and services. These prohibitions are absolute and non-negotiable: (a) Illegal Goods — any product whose manufacture, sale, distribution, or possession is prohibited under applicable law; (b) Counterfeit and Infringing Items — goods that infringe upon any trademark, copyright, patent, trade secret, or other intellectual property right; (c) Weapons and Dangerous Materials — firearms, ammunition, explosives, military-grade equipment, and hazardous materials not handled under proper regulatory authorisation; (d) Controlled Substances and Drugs — illegal narcotics, controlled substances, drug paraphernalia; (e) Sanctioned and Export-Controlled Goods — goods involving sanctioned persons, prohibited counterparties, or jurisdictions prohibited under applicable sanctions requirements; (f) Adult Content and Obscene Material; (g) Gambling and Games of Chance — unlicensed gambling equipment or services constituting illegal gambling; (h) Pyramid Schemes and Multi-Level Marketing involving recruitment-based structures prohibited by payment-provider requirements; (i) Human Trafficking and Exploitation; (j) Endangered Species and Wildlife Products in violation of CITES or applicable law; and (k) Unapproved Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices not cleared by applicable regulatory authorities. ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD independently reserves the right to review, reject, suspend, or cancel any request that presents compliance concerns. This list is illustrative and not exhaustive.

sections.heading: 4. Compliance with Laws
sections.body: Customers are responsible for providing truthful and complete information and for complying with legal obligations applicable to them, including applicable export-control, sanctions, customs, and import requirements. ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD independently applies its own risk-based order review and reserves the right to reject, pause, suspend, or cancel transactions that present sanctions, export-control, customs, intellectual-property, prohibited-product, payment-provider, fraud, or other compliance concerns. Customers must maintain all necessary licences, permits, and regulatory approvals required to conduct their business and must provide copies of such documentation to ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD upon request.

sections.heading: 5. Intellectual Property
sections.body: All intellectual property rights in and to the services, branding, website content, and proprietary methodologies of ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD are and shall remain the exclusive property of the Company. Customers may not use our trademarks, service marks, logos, or trade names without prior written authorisation, and may not reproduce, distribute, or modify our proprietary materials. Customers represent and warrant that all goods, content, and materials they submit for procurement or fulfillment do not infringe upon the intellectual property rights of any third party.

sections.heading: 6. Customer Responsibility
sections.body: Customers are fully responsible for all activity conducted under their orders and accounts, including the actions of their employees, contractors, and agents. Customers must: (a) provide complete, accurate, and up-to-date information regarding their identity, business, products, and order requirements; (b) promptly notify ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD at support@arseenenterprises.co.uk of any errors, unauthorised activity, or concerns regarding their orders; (c) ensure that all persons acting on their behalf are aware of and comply with this Policy; and (d) not misrepresent their identity, business, or the nature of the goods they are requesting to procure or ship.

sections.heading: 7. Enforcement
sections.body: ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD reserves the right to investigate any suspected violation of this Policy and to take appropriate action, which may include, without limitation: (a) issuing a formal warning and requiring corrective action; (b) temporarily suspending access to some or all services pending investigation; (c) permanently terminating the client's service agreement without refund of prepaid fees; (d) removing, refusing, or returning any goods that violate this Policy; (e) reporting suspected illegal activity to appropriate law enforcement agencies, regulatory bodies, or payment processors; (f) cooperating fully with law enforcement investigations; and (g) pursuing civil legal remedies, including injunctive relief and monetary damages.

sections.heading: 8. Reporting Violations
sections.body: We take violations of this Policy seriously and encourage all parties to report suspected violations promptly. If you become aware of any activity that may violate this Policy, please contact us immediately at support@arseenenterprises.co.uk. Please provide as much detail as possible, including the nature of the suspected violation, relevant dates and times, and any supporting documentation. All reports will be treated with confidentiality to the extent permitted by law. ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD prohibits retaliation against any person who, in good faith, reports a suspected violation of this Policy.

sections.heading: 9. Payment Processor Compliance
sections.body: ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD processes payments through authorised payment processors and financial institutions. All payment transactions are subject to the terms and acceptable use policies of the respective payment processor in addition to this Policy. Clients may not use any accepted payment method to fund, facilitate, or conceal any prohibited activity listed in this Policy.

sections.heading: 10. Sanctions and Export-Control Compliance
sections.body: ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD does not knowingly accept transactions or arrange shipments involving sanctioned persons, prohibited counterparties, or jurisdictions prohibited under applicable sanctions requirements. Relevant customer, counterparty, product, and destination information is reviewed in accordance with ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD's risk-based compliance procedures. ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD reserves the right to decline, suspend, or cancel any order that it determines, in its sole discretion, may present sanctions, export-control, or related compliance concerns, without liability to the customer.

sections.heading: 11. Amendments
sections.body: ARSEEN ENTERPRISES LTD reserves the right to modify, update, or replace this Acceptable Use Policy at any time in its sole discretion. Changes will be effective upon posting the revised Policy to our website or upon direct notification to clients via email. The 'Last Updated' date at the top of this Policy reflects the date of the most recent revision. Continued use of our services following the posting of any changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Policy. Material changes that significantly affect client rights or obligations will be communicated with at least thirty (30) days' advance notice where practicable.

sections.heading: Questions about this policy?
sections.body: Our team is available to clarify any aspect of this Acceptable Use Policy. Contact us at support@arseenenterprises.co.uk. Registered Office: Office 1878 85 Dunstall Hill, Wolverhampton, WV6 0SR, United Kingdom.
